channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: UFO over Colorado military base? Two alleged videos remain classified despite Trump’s disclosure order
item.description: The alleged Colorado videos are therefore significant primarily as an example of the evidence whistleblowers say exists but cannot publicly disclose. Until the footage is released and independently examined, the claims about the object shown in the videos cannot be verified.

item.title: Quote of the Day by Cate Blanchett: ‘If you know you are going to fail, then fail gloriously!’
item.description: Cate Blanchett’s words, “If you know you are going to fail, then fail gloriously!”, reflect her fearless approach to acting and a career defined by ambitious choices, reinvention and creative risk-taking.

item.title: H-1B visa rules may tighten: US weighs scrapping 60-day job-loss grace period: What it means for Indians
item.description: For H-1B workers, the current grace period provides valuable time to find another employer and maintain their immigration status. Removing it could mean that workers and their families have far less time to respond to a sudden job loss.

item.title: PM Modi receives call from JD Vance, discusses India-US ties and congratulates US VP on birth of son
item.description: It was not immediately clear whether the proposed India-US trade agreement was discussed during the call.

item.title: Quote of the Day by Jorge Messi on raising Lionel Messi: ‘Who is prepared for all this? Maybe nobody is…’
item.description: Jorge Messi, though never a celebrated figure himself, played a pivotal role in nurturing Lionel Messi's talent. His humble approach to fatherhood, characterized by observing others and providing support, enabled his son to become a football icon.

item.title: Canada’s deportation drive hits Indians hard: 3,323 sent back so far this year — Inside the sharp rise since 2021
item.description: Data released by the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA) shows that the number of Indians deported between January and June this year has already reached nearly 88% of the 3,779 removals recorded throughout 2025, which was previously the highest annual figure.

item.title: ‘Cockroach in ear’: Passenger shares Facebook post narrating horrifying ordeal on Rajdhani Express
item.description: The passenger detailed the physical trauma, the initial misdiagnosis by a railway doctor at Kanpur, and the unhygienic conditions inside the premium AC coach, and demanded accountability from the Indian Railways.

item.title: ‘We don’t trust Iran’: JD Vance says US working on safe shipping route through Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Vance's latest remarks come on a day when Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said that the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz depends on Washington accepting Tehran’s conditions, distancing the issue from ongoing negotiations between Iran and Oman.

item.title: 21 TN MPs oppose proposed delimitation at CM Vijay's meet; DMK, AIADMK stay away
item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay's meeting on delimitation saw 21 of the state's 57 MPs oppose any reduction in the state's parliamentary representation. The DMK and AIADMK stayed away, exposing divisions over the Centre's proposed exercise.

item.title: Who could succeed Mojtaba Khamenei? Iran's Supreme Leader's health reportedly worsens
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei's health is reportedly worsening, with concerns over his condition growing among senior officials. His prolonged absence from public view has also fuelled speculation about his ability to lead and possible succession plans.

item.title: UAE accuses Iran of missile attack on its vessel in Strait of Hormuz; no casualties reported
item.description: The UAE Foreign Ministry said Iran fired a missile at a vessel affiliated with Abu Dhabi’s state-owned oil company ADNOC while it was transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: ‘Doglapanti’: Raghav Chadha faces massive backlash over viral photos with PM Narendra Modi
item.description: Raghav Chadha has faced public backlash after defecting from AAP to the BJP, resulting in severe online trolling and a loss of followers. &nbsp;Now, his photos with PM Modi spark further trolling.

item.title: ‘Not Baba Bageshwar, but…’: PM Modi jokes with IIT Delhi graduates | WATCH
item.description: Modi also told students to question things accepted without a thought and stressed that they should not stop at questioning but also have the courage to find their own solutions.

item.title: Keralam Lower Primary School Teacher rank holders eat grass in protest — why are they demonstrating for over a month?
item.description: LPST rank holders protested outside the Kerala Secretariat by eating grass, voicing frustration over delayed appointment orders. Their agitation has lasted over 34 days, with ‘no action’ from the government and ongoing allegations of irregularities in the PSC examination process.

item.title: Porter Airlines flight to Toronto canceled after a child refuses seatbelt, leaving passengers stranded overnight
item.description: Flight PD444 had departed the terminal at Victoria International Airport (YYJ) in British Columbia on Thursday (August 6), and was heading toward the runway when crew members noticed the child standing in their seat.

item.title: Meghan Markle wears Princess Diana’s diamond and sapphire earrings on date night with Prince Harry
item.description: Meghan Markle wore Princess Diana’s diamond and sapphire earrings while joining Prince Harry in Canada to support David Foster’s 40 years of fundraising.

item.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz will reopen only if US accepts Tehran’s conditions
item.description: The comments add uncertainty to diplomatic efforts aimed at restoring commercial shipping through the strategically vital waterway.

item.title: Trump’s UK grant push for ‘public education’ courses: Why US embassy’s $500,000 scheme is raising concerns
item.description: The funding announcement, which uses terminology embraced by the pro-Trump Maga movement, says the programmes should seek to encourage a ‘national conversation’ on the 'shared civilizational values' that form the basis of US-UK relations.

item.title: IAF officer ‘honey-trapped’ by Pakistani agent; arrested for sharing secret defence information
item.description: The IAF officer is also accused of installing data-stealing software on a colleague's mobile phone in an alleged attempt to gain control of the device

item.title: Flesh-eating bacteria alert in Louisiana: Vibrio vulnificus cases rise; 5 people die after exposure to seawater
item.description: Vibrio infections can cause gastrointestinal illness, wound infections and bloodstream infections, health officials said.

item.title: Spain begins process to replace ambassador to India over alleged financial favours: Report
item.description: Spain has begun the process to replace its ambassador to India, Juan Antonio March Pujol, following allegations of accepting financial favours and using embassy funds to promote cultural events. The allegations were reported by Spanish media and referred to the Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office.

item.title: New York City homeowners challenge Mamdani’s new pied-à-terre tax, seek September deadline halt
item.description: The legal challenge does not seek to overturn the tax itself. Instead, it targets the city’s assessment roll and notices sent to property owners who may be liable for the surcharge.

item.title: Turkey restricts Black Sea Ship traffic after surge in attacks
item.description: Turkey is restricting commercial ship traffic into the Black Sea, according to people familiar with the matter, following growing concern from the government after an uptick in Russian and Ukrainian attacks on vessels in the area.

item.title: Amazon case: Why did Bombay High Court say Tukaram Mundhe-led FDA was ‘killing a mosquito with a sword’?
item.description: The Bombay High Court criticised the Maharashtra FDA for excessive actions against an Amazon warehouse, urging a more measured approach. The court questioned the appropriateness of shutting down businesses for regulatory violations, highlighting procedural concerns during an ongoing appeal.

item.title: MeitY asks Meta to revamp algorithms, submit roadmap to curb deepfakes: Report
item.description: MeitY has asked Meta to revamp its algorithms and submit a compliance roadmap to tackle deepfakes, propaganda and manipulated content, sources said. The government also wants faster takedowns, stronger moderation and closer coordination to curb harmful content.

item.title: Jorge Messi, Lionel Messi's father, passes away at 68; Nico Paz pays tribute
item.description: Jorge Messi has played a key role in his son's soccer career, acting as his agent and managing his business affairs off the field.

item.title: Delhi tragedy: Mercedes-Maruti WagonR collision kills 70-year-old woman in Narela; What did preliminary probe reveal?
item.description: Delhi accident: The tragedy occurred around 8 am near Himalayas Apartment in Mamurpur when a Mercedes and a Maruti WagonR collided. After the crash, a team from the Narela police station reached the site and began probing the incident.

item.title: Canada’s PSP is said to mull $1.5 billion sale of roads in India
item.description: The Public Sector Pension Investment Board is exploring options for its roads in India, including a sale, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: 'Why link it to delimitation?': Rahul Gandhi, Rijiju spar over Women's Reservation Bill
item.description: Rahul Gandhi and Kiren Rijiju sparred over the implementation of the Women's Reservation Bill, with Gandhi demanding its implementation without conditions and Rijiju arguing that delimitation is necessary to ensure the quota takes effect from 2029.

item.title: ‘Swachh Bharat movement started a decade ago, but...’: Kiran Shaw backs Suhel Seth's call for better, cleaner cities
item.description: Both Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw and Suhel Seth have been very vocal about the condition of the cities they live in — often bashing the administrations for the lack.

item.title: After Ukraine, Russia has eyes on other NATO-allied countries? US intel claims Vladimir Putin seeks to…
item.description: According to the officials, the assessments reportedly point to a change in Putin's risk calculus compared with just a few months ago, indicating a greater willingness to take actions that could test NATO's response without directly triggering a conventional conflict.

item.title: Mecca Joint Defence Agreement: Will Saudi and Turkey fight if Pakistan is attacked?
item.description: If India launches another Operation Sindoor-style strike on Pakistan, will Saudi Arabia and Turkey come to Islamabad's aid? The Mecca defence pact raises questions over collective defence, but does not necessarily mean either country would directly enter a war.

item.title: US Senate averts shutdown before Midterms, curbs Trump on Border Patrol funds, delays Hemp ban
item.description: The vote was 90-6, with one senator voting present, to keep federal funding flowing at current levels through December 11 and bar the Trump administration from transferring funds to the Border Patrol

item.title: Trump's big move to counter China over critical minerals includes over ₹28,100 crore investment — here's how
item.description: President Trump announced a $3 billion investment in critical minerals and battery projects to enhance domestic production and national security. He emphasised the importance of the sector to bolster US mineral independence and reduce reliance on China.

item.title: Not just Bhandara! On menu of Kanwar camps in Uttar Pradesh — Onion-garlic free pizza, momo, hakka noodles & more
item.description: UP government said district authorities are also continuously inspecting private camps to monitor food quality, hygiene standards, and overall arrangements.
